source_name: Federal Reserve - H.10 Foreign Exchange Rates
title: Foreign Exchange Rates - Correction to H.10
summary_raw:
Due to a technical issue, the August 10, 2026, H.10 release included incorrect data for August 3 for all currencies and the dollar indexes.

The issue has been corrected on August 12, 2026. The corresponding entries
were also corrected in the Data Download Program.
